title: Understand attachment and keep choice open

captions.physics: Act from experience and share understanding
captions.energy: Notice the binding power of desire

meaning: Your union can handle strong attachment more clearly when experience helps open a choice rather than only explain why continuation is necessary.
text: In your partnership, understood experience may coexist with something shared that is difficult to release. In the physical position, the Hermit expresses thoughtful actions and passing on understanding. In energy, the Devil describes the motive: a strong pull making stopping difficult. In emotions, the Devil returns differently, conveying restriction when something desired seems necessary for calm. These roles make no limitation inevitable, but distinguish what prompts action from how the possibility of refusing feels. A clear explanation of attachment can be useful without yet establishing that both people have genuine access to another way of participating.

For example, you discuss a substantial collection assembled together. Experience explains each part’s value, but freeing even a little space feels increasingly difficult. Reducing it seems like losing your history. **Understanding can preserve value without requiring the entire earlier scale to remain.** A treasured part may be kept while other objects continue elsewhere. This need not dismiss the past as wasted or establish that earlier pleasure was unreal.

Attachment strengthens if every explanation only defends the familiar. You understand more clearly why release is hard, yet no new choice becomes available. Depth of conversation supports restriction. Experience helps when it permits a modest real step before every feeling is fully analysed. Scope can change while respect, regret and revision remain possible, without making one shared form the sole proof of genuine closeness.
